_readme: A payload for the cleaning-schedule skill, for developing the cleaning team's app in
this repository without reaching the real store and without a live door code ever
being on this machine. Every code and every phone number below is invented and none
of them opens anything. The Thai in it is reused from the skill and the brief, never
written here. The README section on this app has the two commands that turn it into a
documents file, and CLEANING_LOCAL_PATH in .env.example is where that file is named.
Dates move: edit the jobs so some of them are in the future, or the whole fixture
renders as a schedule that has already happened.

cleaning.th: คิวทำความสะอาดบ้านช้างคลาน 42 ซอย1

laundry.th: คิวส่งผ้าบ้านช้างคลาน 42 ซอย1

เพิ่มเตียง 1 ที่ และผ้าปูอีกชุด
